# Host-native FBL03 fixture (no device access)

This committed fixture is a frozen, attributable historical SL101 Grate/Mesa 25.0.7-derived source slice, **not** a pristine Mesa upstream checkout. The original untracked file was `work/SL101-LINUX-03-FP-FRC-DP-20261102-5A88BE/rebased-base.c`, SHA-256 `2f5f5ebc6a582fe9205f757fb43b79c1150ba780eb09d534bfd936f3c6ea276f`. It was copied unchanged as `rebased-base.c`. Its full prior rebasing history is **unreconstructed**, a provenance limitation that must not be elided. Headers and the 14-case harness were copied from the original lane03 private fixture without modification. Exact file hashes, original packet lineage, patch hashes and strict order appear in `manifest.json`.

## Host-only preparation

1. Obtain a **compatible configured Mesa/Grate 25.0.7 build tree**, with source/include layout and the `src/gallium/drivers/grate/libgrate.a.p/fp_tgsi.c.o` Ninja target. The current local one is `build/mesa-grate-clean/mesa-25.0.7/builddir` (ignored, **not** distributed here). The existing tarball `build/mesa-grate-clean/mesa-25.0.7.tar.xz` hashes to `592272df3cf01e85e7db300c449df5061092574d099da275d19e97ef0510f8a6`, but **the tarball alone does not reconstruct this Grate build configuration**. Lane06 must supply/verifiably pin the complete source and build recipe. Do not claim that a fresh checkout can already reconstruct that external build.
2. Run `python3 scripts/sl101-fbl03-native-qualify.py --mesa-build /path/to/mesa/builddir` (or export `SL101_FBL03_MESA_BUILD`). The runner checks all committed inputs against SHA-256, strictly applies 0012 then 0037 with `git apply --check` and `git apply` in an isolated temporary directory, verifies the patched source hash, extracts the Grate compile flags from Ninja, compiles with host GCC and **executes** the 14 native C assertions. Any missing inputs, failed replay, missing build, compiler failure, or failed assertion produces a nonzero process exit.
3. `python3 -m unittest tests.test_sl101_fbl03_fp_dp2` is an ordinary optional unit-test entry; **a skip is not native qualification**. Use the strict command for acceptance.

This is structural emission coverage (FRC/DP2/DP3/DP4, swizzle, modifiers, aliases, writemasks, scratch exhaustion and error paths). Neither numerical execution of emitted GPU instructions, complete Mesa shader compilation/link, Skia raster pixels nor SL101 hardware compatibility is proven. Current shared source replay failed historically and must not be overwritten. Patch-series and full provenance coordination belongs to lane06. No device build/deployment, SSH, public submission or renderer default changes are permitted.
